items.statement: 核心結果完整保留：σ_NLO = 48.2 fb，尺度不確定度 +9.5% / −11.0%，PDF 不確定度 ±4.1%。
items.how_to_judge: held when the condensed outline states 48.2 fb together with the asymmetric scale uncertainty +9.5%/−11.0% and the PDF ±4.1%, not_held when the central value is missing, an uncertainty is dropped, or the asymmetric scale uncertainty is symmetrised (e.g. '±10%').
held when the condensed outline carries both the preliminary and the synthetic labels (title and/or summary), not_held when either label is dropped.

items.statement: 窄寬度近似的適用條件 Γ_S/m_S < 5% 保留。
items.how_to_judge: held when the narrow-width condition with the 5% threshold is stated, not_held when it is dropped or stated without the condition.

items.statement: 範圍限制保留：僅膠子融合、未含電弱修正。
items.how_to_judge: held when the outline says the prediction covers gluon fusion only and excludes electroweak corrections, not_held when either scope limitation is dropped.

items.statement: 重頂夸克縮放僅在 300–1000 GeV 驗證的限制保留。
items.how_to_judge: held when the 300–1000 GeV validity range of the heavy-top rescaling is kept, not_held when it is dropped.

items.statement: 結果所依賴的參數保留：m_S = 600 GeV、√s = 13.6 TeV、Λ = 3 TeV、c_g = 1。
items.how_to_judge: held when the benchmark parameters needed to interpret 48.2 fb (at least m_S, √s and Λ) are stated, not_held when the result is quoted without its benchmark point or a parameter is changed.

items.statement: 精簡後大綱包含總結投影片，列出核心結果與不確定度。
items.how_to_judge: held when a summary/conclusion slide exists in the condensed outline with the central result and its uncertainties, not_held when there is no summary slide or it lacks the uncertainties.

items.statement: 至少保留一張圖及其圖說（σ_NLO 對 m_S 的圖 3），圖說保留尺度包絡說明與初步／合成標示。
items.how_to_judge: held when the condensed outline keeps Fig. 3 (or another figure) with a caption that states what the band is and the preliminary/synthetic status, not_held when all captions are removed or the caption loses the band description or status.
held when the output is an outline (bullets per slide, captions), not_held when it contains full spoken paragraphs / a word-for-word script for the slides.

items.statement: 不產生逐張時間表或問答準備清單。
items.how_to_judge: held when there is no per-slide minute allocation table and no Q&A bank, not_held when either is produced (a single remark on total length is fine).

items.statement: 不捏造數值，例如電弱修正的估計大小、新的總不確定度或其他質量點的截面。
items.how_to_judge: held when every number in the output appears in the input (or is a clearly labelled arithmetic combination of input numbers), not_held when it introduces an unsourced number such as an EW correction size or a cross section at another mass.

items.statement: 總結投影片寫 K = 1.48，但第 6 張寫 K = 1.62，而 48.2/29.8 ≈ 1.62；輸出必須指出此不一致。
items.how_to_judge: held when the output reports the K-factor mismatch (1.48 vs 1.62) and uses or recommends 1.62 or asks for confirmation, not_held when the mismatch is not mentioned, including when 1.48 is silently carried or silently replaced.
items.locator_hint: 第 12 張 vs 第 5、6 張
